topic: Scientific Method and Science Process Skills
key_concepts: The scientific method is a systematic way of learning about the world and answering questi
A scientific investigation begins with a problem or question that can be solved through ex
A hypothesis is an educated guess or possible answer based on prior knowledge and observat
A hypothesis is often written in an if-then format
An experiment is a controlled procedure that confirms or rejects a hypothesis
Independent, dependent, and controlled variables are identified in an experiment
Controlled variables or constants must be kept the same to make an experiment fair
A control group does not receive the treatment while an experimental group does
Observations are made using the five senses and can be qualitative or quantitative
Data from experiments should be analyzed and presented systematically using tables or grap
A conclusion is the interpretation of data and answers the hypothesis
Results should be communicated to share the knowledge gained
